name: Object swarm
description: A model from the asset library instanced down a corridor on a golden-angle helix, flying at the camera with rim lighting and a beat-driven pulse. The nearest copy overruns the frame, the rest recede into fog. Falls back to procedural geometry if the asset catalogue is empty.

count.description: Copies alive at once. 1 gives the old single-object showcase.

pitch.description: Spacing down the corridor. Small values pack the swarm and hide the fog; large ones spread it out.

radius.description: How far off the view axis the helix swings. 0 puts every copy dead centre and they queue up in a line.

flow.description: How fast the swarm comes at the camera. Negative sends it away.

swirl.description: Rotation of the whole helix about the view axis.

spin.description: Each copy's own spin. Rates vary per copy, so they never turn in unison.

wire.description: 1 draws the models as glowing wireframe-ish facets instead of solid.
